header: Understand the analyst report in threat analytics in Microsoft Defender
content:
analytics in Microsoft Defender
Applies to:
Microsoft Defender XDR
Each threat analytics report includes dynamic sections and a comprehensive written section
called the analyst report. To access this section, open the report about the tracked threat and
select the Analyst report tab.
Analyst report section of a threat analytics report
A threat analytics report can be classified under one of the following categories:
Activity – Provides information on a specific attack campaign that's often associated with
a threat actor. This report discusses how an attack happened, why you should care about
it, and how Microsoft protects its customers from it. An activity report might also include
details like timeline of events, attack chains, and behaviors and methodologies.
